senses.gloss:
हस् 1. हस्, cl. 1. P. हसति, जहास, हसि-
ष्यति, अहसीत्, हसितुम्, to laugh, smile;
to laugh at, ridicule (with acc.); to resemble, (see
हसत्): Pass. हस्यते, Aor. अहासि: Caus. हासयति,
यितुम्, Aor. अजीहसत्, to cause to laugh, make laugh,
provoke laughter: Desid. जिहसिषति: Intens. जा-
हस्यते, जाहस्ति, to laugh immoderately; [cf. per-
haps Gr. τω-θεία, τω-θάζω; probably Lat. histrio.]

2. हस्, Ved. laughter, joy; brightness, brilliance.
—हस्-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. causing joy or
prosperity; making bright, (Sāy. = वृद्धेः कर्तृ
or प्रभासक, Ṛg-veda IV. 7, 3.)
—हस्-कार,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing brightness or radiance (said
of lightning; Sāy. = दीप्ति-कर, Ṛg-veda I. 23,
12).
—हस्-कृति, इस्, f., Ved. a song of praise; (इस्,
इस्, इ), causing joy, (Sāy. = हास-कारिन् or हर्षस्य
सूचक, Ṛg-veda VIII. 89, 6.)

हस, अस्, m. laughter, laughing, a laugh; de-
rision.
—हसा-मुदौ, m. du., Ved. laughing and
rejoicing.

हास, अस्, m. laughing, laughter; mirth, merry-
making, joy; derision.
—हास-कर, अस्, ई, अम्,
causing laughter, ridiculous; laughing, merry.
हास हास, हासक, &c. See p. 1168, col. 3.

हसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, laughing, smiling; resem-
bling (i. e. smiling like, with acc., Kirāt. VIII. 44);
(अन्ती), f. a portable fire-pan, small furnace, chafing-
dish; Arabian jasmine; a kind of Śākinī, q. v.

हसन, अम्, n. the act of laughing, laughter, a
laugh; (आ), f. laughter; a joke, subject of laughter
or ridicule, (Ṛg-veda IX. 112, 4.)

हसनी, f. a portable fire-place or chafing-dish.
—हसनी-मणि, इस्, m. ‘furnace-jewel,’ fire.

हसनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, laughable; to be ridiculed,
ridiculous.

हसन्तिका, f. (fr. हसन्ती), a portable fire-place
or small furnace.
हसिका, f. laughter, derision, jesting.
हासिका, f. laughter, mirth, merry-making.

हसित, अस्, आ, अम्, laughed, laughing, smiling;
expanded, blossomed, blown (as a flower); (अम्), n.
laughter, jesting; smiling; the bow of Kāma (god
of love).

हसितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who laughs, a laugher,
smiler.
हसित्वा, ind. having laughed, having smiled.

हस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, smiling; stupid, ignorant, a
fool.
हस्र हस्र. See p. 1168, col. 3.

हासक, अस्, m. a laugher; one who causes
laughter, a buffoon, merry-andrew.

हासमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. laughing, being de-
lighted, (Sāy. = हासं कुर्वत्, हर्ष-युक्त.)
हासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, laughing, smiling, making merry.

हास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be laughed at, laughable,
ridiculous; (अम्), n. laughter, laughing, mirth (one
of the ten Rasas, see रस), jest, amusement; ridi-
cule, derision.
—हास्य-ता, f. laughableness, ridicu-
lousness.
—हास्य-पदवी, f. ‘road of laughter,’
ridicule, laughter, (हास्य-पदवीं या, to expose
one's self to laughter, incur ridicule.)
—हास्य-रस,
अस्, m. the sentiment of humour, sense of humour,
comic vein, facetiousness (the fifth of the ten Rasas,
see रस).
—हास्यार्णव (˚य-अर्˚), अस्, m. ‘ocean
of mirth,’ N. of a drama by Jagad-īśvara.
—हास्या-
स्पद (˚य-आस्˚), अम्, n. a laughing-stock, butt for
derision.
हास्य हास्य. See p. 1168. col. 3.

हस्त हस्त, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.
III. 86. fr. rt. 1. हस्), the hand; the thirteenth as-
terism, (see below); the fore-arm, cubit; a measure
of length from the elbow to the tip of the middle
finger (= twenty-four Aṅgulas or about eighteen
inches); an elephant's trunk; (in prosody) an ana-
pest; quantity, abundance, mass, (in this sense only
at end of comps. and when compounded with words
signifying ‘hair;’ cf. केश-हस्त); (आ), f. the thir-
teenth lunar asterism (represented by a hand and
containing five stars, identified by some with part of
the constellation Corvus); (अम्), n. a pair of leather
bellows; (ए), ind. in hand, in one's possession; [cf.
Gr. χανδ-άν-ω (ἔ-χαδ-ον, κέ-χανδ-α, χείσομαι);
Lat. pre-hend-o, hed-era (?) ; Goth. bi-git-an,
handu; Angl. Sax. gitan (= Eng. get), hand.]
—हस्त-कमल, अम्, n. a lotus carried in the
hand (thus when Lakṣmī was churned out of the
ocean, she appeared holding a lotus).
—हस्त-कौ-
शल, अम्, n. skilfulness of hand, manual dexterity.
—हस्त-क्रिया, f. any manual performance.
—हस्त-
गत, अस्, आ, अम्, come to hand, fallen into one's
possession, procured, gained, obtained, secured.
[]
—हस्त-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—हस्त-
गृह्य, ind., Ved. having taken the hand.
—हस्त-
घ्न, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of arm-guard or shield
(defending the fore-arm from the blows of the bow-
string).
—हस्त-चापल्य, अम्, n. = हस्त-कौशल.
—हस्त-च्छेदन, अम्, n. the amputation of a
hand.
—हस्त-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. shaken or
moved with the hand, moved or thrown violently
by means of the hand.
—हस्त-च्युति, इस्, f., Ved.
moving or shaking about with the hand, (according to
Sāy. हस्त-च्युती = हस्त-प्रच्युत्या, हस्त-गत्या,
Ṛg-veda VII. 1, 1.)
—हस्त-ज्योडि, इस्, m. a kind of
tree or plant (= कर-ज्योडि).
—हस्त-तल, अम्, n.
the palm of the hand; the tip of an elephant's
trunk.
—हस्त-ताल, अस्, m. clapping the hands
together.
—हस्त-त्रय-सम्मिते, ind. at a distance
of three Hastas.
—हस्त-दोष, अस्, m. a slip of
the hand, mistake committed by the hand.
—हस्त-
धात्री = हस्तामलक.
—हस्त-धारण, अम्, n.
warding off a blow; stopping a blow with the hand.
—हस्त-पादादि (˚द-आदि), the hands and feet
&c., the extremities, the limbs of the body.
—हस्त-
पुच्छ, अम्, n. the lower part of the fore-arm, the
hand below the wrist.
—हस्त-पृष्ठ, अम्, n.
the back of the hand (also called अप-पृष्ठ).
—हस्त-प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reached with the hand,
held in the hand; obtained, secured (= कर-प्राप्त).
—हस्त-मणि, इस्, m. a jewel worn on the wrist.
—हस्त-मात्र, a cubit in length, (see मात्र.)
—हस्त-युगल, अम्, n. the two hands.
—हस्त-
रत्नावली (˚न-आव्˚), f., N. of a work by Rāghava
(treating of the various movements of the hands
&c.).
—हस्त-रेखा, f. a line on the hand.
—हस्त-
लाघव, अम्, n. lightness of hand, manual readiness,
smartness, cleverness, legerdemain.
—हस्त-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, having hands, handy, dexterous, clever,
skilful.
—हस्त-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being or remain-
ing in the hand, seized, held, caught hold of.
—हस्त-वारण, अम्, n. restraining the hand (of
another); warding off a blow.
—हस्त-विम्ब, अम्,
n. perfuming or smearing the body with unguents
&c.
—हस्त-संवाहन, अम्, n. rubbing or sham-
pooing with the hands.
—हस्त-सिद्धि, इस्, f. per-
forming or effecting anything with the hand, manual
labour; hire, wages, salary.
—हस्त-सूत्र or हस्त-
सूत्रक, ‘hand-ribbon;’ (अम्), n. a bracelet worn
on the wrist.
—हस्त-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, staying in the
hand, being in hand, held, grasped.
—हस्त-स्थित,
अस्, आ, अम्, being in hand, held.
—हस्ताक्षर (˚त-
अक्˚), अम्, n. one's own sign manual, autograph,
signature, handwriting.
—हस्ताग्र (˚त-अग्˚), अम्,
n. the extremity of the hand, the fingers.
—हस्ता-
ग्र-लग्न (˚त-अग्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘joined hand in
hand,’ married; [cf. पाणि-ग्रह.]
—हस्ताङ्गुलि
(˚त-अङ्˚), इस्, f. ‘hand-finger,’ any finger of the
hand.
—हस्तामलक (˚त-आम्˚), अस्, m., N. of one
of the four principal disciples of Śaṅkarācārya; (अम्),
n. the fruit of Emblic Myrobalan held in the hand;
N. of a short work by Hastāmalaka (containing the
elements of the Vedānta).
—हस्तामलक-भा-
ष्य, अम्, n. a commentary on the above by Śaṅ-
karācārya.
—हस्तावलम्ब (˚त-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
supported by the hand of another.
—हस्तावाप
(˚त-आव्˚), अस्, m. ‘hand-bracelet,’ a finger-guard,
arm-guard (used by archers, = ज्याघात-वारण).
—हस्ता-हस्ति, ind. hand to hand.
—हस्ते-करण,
अम्, n. ‘taking by the hand,’ marriage (= पाणौ-
करण).
—हस्ते-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to
take in hand, take possession of, make one's own.
—हस्ते-कृत्य, ind. having taken possession of.

हास्त हास्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. हस्त), formed
by the hands.
हस्तक, अस्, m. a position of the hands.

हस्तिक, अस्, n. a multitude or collection of ele-
phants (= गज-त).

हास्तिक हास्तिक, अस्, r. (fr. हस्तिन्), an
elephant-rider, elephant-driver, &c.; (अम्), n. a
herd or collection of elephants.

हस्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having hands, having a trunk;
(ई), m. an elephant, (four kinds of elephants are
specified, each characterized by particular marks; see
भद्र, मन्द्र, मृग, मिश्र; some give कि-
लिञ्ज-हस्तिन्, a traw elephant, effigy of an elephant
made of grass); N. of a son of king Su-hotra (a prince
of the Lunar race, described in Viṣṇu-Purāṇa IV.
19. as founder of Hastinā-pura); a kind of plant, =
[]
अज-मोदा; (इनी), f. a female elephant; a woman
of a particular class (one of the four into which
females are divided; a woman of this class is de-
scribed as having thick lips, thick hips, thick fingers,
large breasts, dark complexion, and libidinous ap-
petite); a kind of drug and perfume.
—हस्ति-कक्-
ष्य, अस्, m. a lion; a tiger.
—हस्ति-कन्द, अस्,
m. a kind of tree or bulbous plant (described as a sort
of Arum, = गज-कन्द).
—हस्ति-करञ्ज, अस्, m.
a kind of tree (= महा-करञ्ज).
—हस्ति-कर्ण,
अस्, m. ‘elephant-eared,’ the castor-oil tree (also the
red kind); a kind of Palāśa tree; another tree or
bulbous plant (= हस्ति-कन्द); a particular class of
semi-divine beings (forming one of the गण-देवता,
q. v.); N. of a district.
—हस्ति-कर्णक, अस्, m. a
kind of Palāśa tree.
—हस्तिकर्ण-दल, अस्, m.
a sort of Palāśa tree.
—हस्ति-कोलि, इस्, m. a sort of
jujube.
—हस्ति-गिरि, इस्, m. the city and district of
Kāñcī, q. v.
—हस्ति-घट, N. of the seventh book
of the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa.
—हस्ति-घोषा or
हस्ति-घोषातकी, f. a kind of creeper (= ऐभी,
महा-कोशातकी).
—हस्ति-घ्न, अस्, m. an elephant-
killer; a man.
—हस्ति-चारिन्, ई, m. an elephant-
driver; (इणी), f. a kind of tree (= महा-करञ्ज).
—हस्ति-दन्त, अस्, m. the tusk of an elephant; a
radish; a pin or peg projecting from a wall; (अम्),
n. ivory; a radish.
—हस्ति-दन्तक, अम्, n. a
radish.
—हस्तिदन्त-फला, f. a kind of cucumber
(= एर्वारु).
—हस्ति-द्वयस, अस्, ई, अम् (Gram.
80. XX), as high or as big as an elephant, elephantine.
—हस्ति-नख, अम्, n. ‘elephant's nail,’ a sort of
turret or raised mound of earth or masonry protecting
the access to the gate of a city or fort, (it is described as
furnished with an inner staircase, and affording means
for discharging arrows &c. at an enemy.)
—हस्ति-
प or हस्तिपक, अस्, m. an elephant-driver, ele-
phant-rider; an elephant-keeper.
—हस्ति-पत्त्र,
अस्, m. = हस्ति-कन्द.
—हस्ति-पर्णिका, f. a kind
of plant (= राज-कोशातकी).
—हस्ति-पर्णी, f. a
kind of plant (= मोरटा); a sort of gourd (= कर्-
कटी).
—हस्ति-पाद, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, elephant-
footed.
—हस्ति-पाल, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—हस्ति-
पृष्ठक, अम्, n. the back of an elephant.
—हस्ति-मद, अस्, m. the ichor or exudation from
an elephant's temples when in rut.
—हस्ति-मल्ल,
अस्, m., N. of Airāvata (Indra's elephant); of Ga-
ṇeśa; of Śaṅkha (the eighth of the chief Nāgas or
serpents of Pātāla); a heap of ashes; a shower of
dust; frost, cold.
—हस्ति-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, as
great as an elephant.
—हस्ति-यूथ, अम्, n. a herd
of elephants.
—हस्ति-राज, अस्, m. the king or chief
of elephants.
—हस्ति-रोहणक, अस्, m. a kind of
tree (= महा-करञ्ज).
—हस्ति-लोध्रक, अस्, m.
the Lodhra tree.
—हस्ति-वध or हस्ति-बध, अस्,
m. the killing of an elephant (especially by a lion,
which incurs the guilt of murder, whilst others carry
off the spoils, such as the tusks and the pearls said to
be found in the head).
—हस्ति-वर्चस, अम्, n. the
magnificence of an elephant.
—हस्ति-वाह, अस्, m.
an elephant-driver; a hook for driving elephants.
—हस्ति-विषाणी, f. the Kadalī tree.
—हस्ति-वै-
द्यक, N. of a work by Vīra-soma.
—हस्ति-शाला,
f. an elephant-stable.
—हस्ति-शुण्ड, अस्, m. or
हस्ति-शुण्डा, f. an elephant's trunk; (आ or ई), f.
the shrub Heliotropium Indicum.
—हस्ति-श्या-
माक, अस्, m. a kind of grain.
—हस्ति-षड्गव,
अम्, n. a yoke or collection of six elephants, (see
षड्-गव.)
—हस्ति-सोमा, f., N. of a river.
—हस्ति-स्नान, अम्, n. the washing of an ele-
phant.
—हस्ति-हस्त, अस्, m. an elephant's trunk.
—हस्ति-हस्त-परामृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, touched
or struck by the trunks of elephants.
—हस्त्य्-अध्य्-
अक्ष, अस्, m. a superintendent or master of ele-
phants.
—हस्त्य्-अश्व-रथ-सम्बाध, अस्, आ, अम्,
crowded with carriages, horses, and elephants.
—हस्त्य्-आयुर्वेद, अस्, m. a work on the treat-
ment of elephants' diseases.
—हस्त्य्-आरोह, अस्, m.
an elephant-rider, elephant-driver.

हस्तिन-पुर, अम्, n. (fr. हस्तिन् + पुर), the
city of Hastin (= हस्तिना-पुर below).

हस्तिना-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a city founded by
[]
king Hastin, q. v., (it was situated about fifty-seven
miles north-east of the modern Dillī or Delhi on the
banks of an old channel of the Ganges, and was the
capital of the kings of the Lunar line, as Ayodhyā
was of the Solar dynasty; hence it forms a central
scene of action in the Mahā-bhārata; here Dhṛta-
rāṣṭra reigned when the government was resigned
by his brother Pāṇḍu, and here the five Pāṇḍava
princes were educated along with their cousins the
Kauravas, and here at the conclusion of the great
war between them Yudhi-ṣṭhira was crowned after
a triumphal progress through the streets of the city;
see Śānti-parvan 1386-1410: other names for this
celebrated town are गजाह्वय, नाग-साह्वय,
नागाह्व, हास्तिन.)
हस्तिनी-पुर, अम्, n. = हस्तिना-पुर above.

हस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the hand, done
with the hand, manual; given with the hand.
हास्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being about to go.

हासस् हासस्, आस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.
IV. 220. fr. rt. 3. हा), Ved. the moon.

हास्तिन, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to
elephants, elephantine, as big as an elephant, huge
(अम्), n. the city of Hastināpura, q. v.
—हास्तिन-
पुर, अम्, n. = हस्तिना-पुर, q. v.
